codebase_patterns.file_structure: src/ for source code (cli.py, core.py, utils.py), tests/ for pytest tests

common_mistakes_to_avoid: Always validate file paths with validate_file_path() from utils.py before processing - prevents path traversal attacks
Don't add redundant validation that argparse already handles (e.g., checking for empty required args)
Move all imports to module level, not inside functions
Remove unused imports from test files
Security tools must clearly indicate stub/prototype status in output
security_patterns: Use os.path.realpath() and os.path.abspath() to resolve paths before validation
Check for path traversal sequences (../) in user-provided paths
Validate output file paths before writing - prevent arbitrary file writes
Don't expose full exception details to users - log internally, show generic messages
testing_patterns: Use conftest.py with shared fixtures (yield + try/finally for cleanup)
Use monkeypatch to simulate filesystem errors (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, IOError)
Separate tests into logical classes (TestFullWorkflows, TestEdgeCases, etc.)
Binary detection: check null bytes + non-printable ratio + MIME types
Temporary file security: set 0o600 permissions, avoid TOCTOU in cleanup
